# Be Still

If I could lift my eyes to the mountains,  
and dare to ponder where my help arrives;  
or like Elijah, in a cave perhaps,  
awaiting a hand to mend my striving;  
I might find in wind,  
or earth, or fire ablaze,  
answers to my searching heart -  
but in the stillness...  
the silence, that enfolds all:  
Hari Om Tat Sat
